blocker.message: Transactional operations require a Node host with process identity, file ownership, and process liveness APIs. This host cannot safely open the operation journal.

remediation.instruction: Start the packaged journal service in a supported Node host and configure operations.journalService.descriptorPath in the browser client.
remediation.label: Use a supported transactional host

error.message: Transactional operations require a Node host with process identity, file ownership, and process liveness APIs. This host cannot safely open the operation journal.
error.name: OperationError
